summary.name: Typeset.md
summary.one_liner: Typeset.md is a free, open-source native Mac reader for Markdown (.md) files that updates in place as files change and shows what changed since you last opened them.
use_cases: Reading plans or specs that change while you work on them
Viewing Markdown output written by AI agents
Browsing a repo's .md files by name across a folder
Previewing .md files in Finder without opening an app
Exporting Markdown to PDF, Word, Pages or Google Docs
Copying a passage with file path and line numbers to give back to an agent
summary.what_it_does: Typeset.md is a native macOS app for reading .md files. It reloads files in place when they change, redrawing only the changed part while keeping your scroll position. A blue bar marks content that is new since you last opened a file. It renders tables, code, alerts, footnotes and task lists, following the Mac's light or dark mode. It supports Finder Quick Look previews, a ⌘K file jump across an opened folder, and printing or exporting to PDF or Rich Text. Users can edit the source with ⌘E, and ticked tasks save back to the file. The app has no accounts, no library or vault, no plugins or themes, and no AI features, and it does not access the internet.
notable: Updates in place and marks what changed since you last opened a file
Finder Quick Look preview of .md files
Sandboxed: no internet access, no account, no library or vault
caveats: Mac only; no other platforms named
No plugins or custom themes; one light and one dark theme
